observations:
Torah #141 is a single-argument micro-teaching (7 lines). It develops exactly two thematic domains, both of which are captured in torah_141_packages.json:

  [Package 1: good] — מִילַת הַלֵּב וְהַחֲרָטָה (Circumcision of the Heart and Repentance)
  ↓ via eitza chain (edges 1416, 1417, 1418, 1945, 2085)
  [Package 2: evil] — לְבָבוֹת הַטִּפּוֹת וְהַנְּשָׁמוֹת הַנִּדָּחוֹת (Hearts of the Scattered Drops)

No third thematic domain is developed. The teaching's only conceptual moves are:
  1. The positive act: circumcising the heart → opening to genuine teshuvah
  2. The ripple effect into the evil realm: the scattered demonic soul-fragments awaken to their true state
  3. The time anchor: Elul as the special time for this (assigned to Package 1 as a bechina addition)

The gap analysis (torah_141_additions.json) found four additional source-text concepts not in the dataset:
  - אלול → attaches naturally to Package 1 (bechina of divine heart-circumcision)
  - לב ערל ואטום → attaches to Package 1 as its negative/evil-polarity aspect
  - מזיקי עלמא → attaches to Package 2 as the identity-characterization of the demonic soul-fragments
  - שאול תחתית / מקום טנופות → attaches to Package 2 as the spatial/ontological bechina of the evil soul-fragments' state

None of these four additions form an independent thematic domain. All attach to one of the two existing packages based on shared nature.

No independent third cluster of 3+ bechina-connected concepts exists in this Torah. The Elul/time cluster has only one bechina statement and attaches to Package 1. There is no separate 'time package', 'verse package', or 'death-and-mourning package' — these are eitza-results at the end of the causal chain (when the man dies, the demonic children follow his bier — this is the consequence described in line 7, not a conceptually independent domain).

Conclusion: Torah #141 yields exactly 2 packages, 9 dataset nodes across both packages (all from eitza edges, classified by shared nature), plus 4 proposed additions from source-text gap analysis, and 0 new packages needed.
